U1.title: Making New Friends at School
U1.content:
Hello, boys and girls! Do you like to make new friends at school? Yes? Here's some of my advice.

First, don't be shy! Try to talk to all of your classmates. Smile and say, "Hello! What's your name?" If you didn't hear the name clearly, try, "Sorry, can you repeat that for me, please?" Then give your name and say, "Nice to meet you!" It's really as simple as that! It's important to get people's names right. If you get them wrong, they might feel sad!

Second, ask questions! Ask about school, sports, music, and more! As you listen, think of more questions to ask. So when your classmate stops talking, you can jump in and ask another question! But remember, you have to be a good listener before you can ask good questions.

Last, don't forget to share! Tell your classmates something interesting about yourself. Then your new friends can get to know you too! Soon enough, you'll be the best of friends!

I hope you find my advice helpful! Now go make some new friends!

U1.title: Section A (Bill's School)
U1.content:
My name is Bill. I'm an English boy. I'm thirteen. I'm a middle school student and now I study at No. 1 Middle School. Now let me introduce my school.

My school is very big and beautiful. There are 100 teachers and 1,200 students. There are many trees and flowers in the school. There are 50 students in our class: 26 girls and 24 boys.

Our classroom is very big. There are six windows and two doors. There is a map and two pictures on the wall. On the front wall, there is a blackboard. Our desks and chairs are new. There isn't a TV, but there is a computer in the classroom.

We study many subjects in school. My favourite subject is Chinese. Our Chinese teacher, Mr. Lin, is a nice teacher. We all like him very much.

I love the colour green. My star sign is Aquarius and I love playing sports such as tennis and baseball. I also love to read, write and blog.

I like animals such as dogs and pandas, and dolphins are my favourite. I once went to a place in New South Wales and I was able to swim with a dolphin.

Another thing is that I am a crazy fan of Harry Potter. My favourite books are the whole Harry Potter series. My favourite cartoon movie is The Lorax.

U1.title: A Letter to a Pen Pal
U1.content:
Dear Mike, I learned your name from a post on the Internet. I want a pen pal in the UK, so I am writing to you.

I'm a Chinese boy and I live in Beijing, the capital city of China. I'm 12 years old and live with my parents and my younger sister. I'm in Class 2, Grade 7.

I like sports and my favourite sport is football. I often play football with my classmates after school. I also like playing ping-pong. I want to be an astronaut when I grow up. I'm in my school ping-pong club. I need to practice ping-pong for two hours every day. Sometimes I play it at school. My friends can come and watch me play.

I'm not very good at Chinese and maths, but I usually get good grades in English. This is because my father has some American friends. They often come to my home. They all speak English, so I can practice my spoken English with them.

My dad's friends also bring me some comic books in English. I often read them when I'm free.

Would you like to be my pen pal? Please write to me and tell me something about yourself.

Yours,
Zhang Peng

U1.title: David and John

U2.title: Family Ties in Names
U2.content:
Hello! My name is Alan, and I'm from the UK. Here most people have a first, middle, and last name. My full name is Alan Luke Wood. Alan is my first name, Luke is my middle name, and Wood is my last name.

We also call the last name a "family name" or "surname". My grandfather also has three names. His full name is George Charles Wood.

My father's name is the same as my grandfather's. Can you guess why? It shows great respect to my grandfather. People call my father George Charles Wood Junior, and they call my grandfather George Charles Wood Senior.

My mother's name was Linda Grant, but now her name is Linda Wood. Why is that? Because in the UK, a woman often changes her family name to her husband's family name.

Sometimes, however, the woman's last name and the man's last name are joined together. This allows both family names to live on. Names show family ties. What do you think?

U2.content:

U3.title: My Floating School
U3.content:
My name is Sadia Khatun. I'm from Bangladesh. It's difficult to walk on some roads in the rainy season here. So how do I go to school? It's easy! The school comes to me!

I study on a "floating school". My floating school is a "school bus" and classroom all in one. The boat picks me up early in the morning. Our classroom is on the boat too.

There are several boats on the river at the same time. Each boat has one teacher and one class. The teacher teaches us all the subjects.

The boat is long and wide. We sit at wooden desks. Big windows bring in lots of sunlight and fresh air. There's a blackboard at the front. There's a computer next to it, and it gets its power from the sun.

At the end of the school day, the boat takes me home. I learn a lot at my school and have fun too. I love my floating school!

U3.title: My School
U3.content:
Hi, my name is Jim. I'm 13 years old and I'm a middle school student. My school is very big.

There are two classroom buildings. Each classroom building has 18 classrooms. We have lessons there. There is also a music room, five science labs, and a library in the buildings. There are many books in the library. Students often do homework or read books there after class.

The office building is next to the classroom buildings. Teachers plan their lessons there. Behind the classroom buildings is a big sports hall. We play sports in the sports hall every day. In the sports hall, we can play football, basketball, and table tennis.

Every Friday afternoon, there is a basketball game or a football game. The games are always exciting.

My school is also very beautiful. There is a big garden near the school gate. There are many beautiful flowers in it. In the centre of the garden, there is a pool. The fish are swimming happily in the pool.

I like my school very much.

U5.title: Alice's Vlog: My Drama Club
U5.content:
Hello! My name is Alice. Welcome to my drama club! This is Mr. Ford, our drama teacher. Mr. Ford is very nice, and he always has great ideas. He helps me so much!

And these are my friends at the drama club. We always have a good time! After practice, we often have pizza. Check out this photo! Mmm... Yummy!

My parents often come to our shows. They record the shows, and we watch them on TV later. Here's a clip from our last show. That's me with the blonde hair! I look cute, don't I?

The drama club can be hard when I have to remember a lot of lines, but it helps me to understand a lot more about the plays.

I'm usually very shy, but when I'm in a play, I no longer feel afraid. Now I'm brave enough to talk, and even sing, in front of lots of people.

I love my drama club—it's never boring!

U5.title: My Favourite Subjects
U5.content:
I love English. It's my favourite subject. I have English every day. I think this language is interesting. Miss Lee is my English teacher. She is very nice. I want to be an English teacher like her.

Some students think history is boring, but I don't think so. I learn about a lot of great people in history lessons. I have history lessons from Tuesday to Thursday. I'm happy to learn history.

Some students don't like maths because they think it's difficult, but I like it best. I think it's very important in our lives. My maths teacher is great. I can learn a lot from him.

But I don't like PE. It's tiring. Art is my favourite subject because I like drawing pictures. I have art on Mondays. My art teacher, Miss Sun, is fun and her lessons are very interesting. I like her lessons very much.

U6.title: Parents' Jobs and Daily Life
U6.content:
Wenwen's mother, China: My mother is a nurse in a hospital. When she works at night, we eat dinner together at 6:30 p.m., and then she goes to work.

Her work starts at 10:00. She checks on each patient every three hours. She finishes work at 8:00 a.m. the next day and arrives home by 9:00. Her bedtime is around 10:30.

She is busy with her work, but when she is free, we go to the park and have a good time together.

Colin's father, the UK: My father is a bin worker. I usually don't see him in the morning because he gets up at 4:00 a.m. He has something to eat and then goes to work.

By 5:00, he is at his first house to empty rubbish bins into a lorry. Work ends around 3:00 p.m. Then he comes to school to pick me up at 4:30. We talk a lot on the way home.

Dinner is at 6:00. After dinner, he watches TV for a while. Then he goes to bed early at 8:30. We try to keep quiet at night so he sleeps well.

Always remember that if you fall, I'll pick you up. Happy birthday, and stay happy every day!

Your best friend forever,
Tina.

To my wonderful mum, I wish you a happy birthday! Thank you so much for taking care of me and loving me every day.

You're such a beautiful and kind woman. I want to be just like you when I grow up.

Your loving daughter,
Amy.

My dear son, it's so wonderful to watch you grow up. I like to see your smile every day! Thank you for bringing joy to the family.

Sometimes you do drive me up the wall with your loud music, but I wouldn't change a thing about you. I love you so much.

Happy birthday! Love you,
Dad.
